name: Optometry
title: Optometry — B.Optom / BSc Optometry
intro: From Class 12 to a registered optometrist: admission, four years including internship, and career routes.

phases.title: Class 11–12 prerequisites
phases.summary: Science with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Maths.
points: Most colleges require Class 12 Science (PCB or PCM) with English.
Minimum marks of 50% are common.
Optics in Class 12 Physics is useful preparation.
Develop good communication and attention to detail.

phases.title: Entrance and admission
points: Apply via university admission portals.
Entrance exams vary by state and institution; some use CUET-UG.
Attend counselling and choose a recognised college.
Verify documents and pay fees.

phases.title: Three years of academics
phases.summary: Ocular anatomy, optics, clinical optometry and contact lenses.
points: Year 1: Anatomy, Physiology, Geometrical and Physical Optics, Biochemistry.
Year 2: Visual Optics, Ocular Disease, Optometric Instruments and Clinical Optometry.
Year 3: Contact Lenses, Low Vision, Binocular Vision, Paediatric Optometry and Community Optometry.
Practical lab sessions and clinical exposure run through the course.

phases.title: One-year clinical internship
phases.summary: Supervised patient care in eye hospitals.
points: Rotate through refraction, contact lens, low vision and ophthalmology clinics.
See patients under supervision and maintain a case log.
Complete the internship before your degree is awarded.
Learn eyewear dispensing and counselling skills.

phases.title: Registration and career
points: Register with the relevant state or national allied-health body where required.
Jobs: optometrist, eye hospital clinician, optical retail manager and contact-lens specialist.
Higher study: M.Optom, MBA in healthcare or Public health.
Entrepreneurship: eye clinics and optical stores.
